design_rationale:
WORKLOG task 1 (pension_income_and_rate_adjustments), revision 3 (round 2 continued: G7, G8 and 1.md finding 5).
STEP 0 DRAW: draw_counts.py --task 1 -> prerequisite_problems 3, factor_counts [4, 4, 6, 5]. Taken: declaration 4, recurring income 4, net worth 6, annual rate redetermination 5.
SCOPE: claims pension_ext_one_time_payment_declaration (declare_lump_sum_cb649dee, user), pension_ext_recurring_income_redetermination (update_countable_income_81bdd26c), pension_ext_net_worth_redetermination (update_net_worth_02de4f94), pension_ext_annual_rate_redetermination (record_annual_rate_redetermination_a1a40d3e); disjoint from task 0.
WORLD (revision 3): hearing loss granted at 10 percent on 2025-09-26 effective 2023-06-01 (release 4805.38 on 2025-10-10, no fee: no agreement before the initial decision), October 2025 paid monthly (175.51), compensation ended 2025-10-31 by election of pension (pension effective 2025-11-01, granted 2025-12-19). On review the rating rose to 30 percent on 2026-09-24 effective 2023-06-01; the increase release 10270.75 (30 less 10 percent rates for 2023-06 to 2025-10) was paid 2026-10-01 with the 20 percent direct-pay fee 2054.15 withheld, net 8216.60, single signature (below 25000). No VA debt is open, so nothing was offset. The IRRRL funding fee 492.00 was refunded 2026-01-21 on the retroactive compensation award. The debt accounts of revision 2 are gone with the factors that read them.
WHY A GOOD TEST: the caller asks VA to work out and record his pension going forward after the second back payment and a care price increase. The root needs the award's recurring income current (December COLAs, FERS reduced COLAs, compensation ended by election) and a net worth that counts the cash actually received (the release sits on the award at its gross since it was paid, pushing net worth to 170771.64, above the 163699 limit), which in turn needs his own declaration of the one-time payments (only releases since the pension took effect, fee within the 20 percent cap, release paid for months before the pension, deposited within the fresh period).
PROBLEM-TREE CARD: root annual redetermination. Edges: root -> recurring income (value_input, income_on_award); root -> net worth (state_gate on pension_awards.net_worth; false at opening: 170771.64 > limit; step 15 sets 155405.76 and the gate holds; skipping it makes the rate 0); net worth -> declaration (value_input, declared_amount); net worth -> recurring income (value_input, income_on_award). Order {declaration, income} -> net worth -> rate; declaration and income commute. Deletion runs: rate without income 22198; rate without net worth 0; net worth without declaration 147189.16; net worth without income 154378.39.
G4 SEPARATION: unchanged; the care-cost adjustment does not fire for a veteran who asked for a redetermination going forward. G2: the redetermined rate (21170, 1764 a month) is lower than the 2288 paid, so it takes effect 2026-10-31 and is paid from November.
BASE-INVARIANT CARD: declaration -> pension_evt_income_change and pension_excl_compensation (no month of both benefits). Net worth and redetermination no longer override the base threshold clause: the threshold is the base 5 percent of the category's medical_deduction_base_mapr (1141.90). Redetermination -> rate computation, income change, medical expenses, net worth and transfers (payability), income match.
FACTOR CARD declaration (4): declaration_period [the pension award took effect fewer than twelve whole months before the declaration] -> baseline gives 13021.98; representative_fee_taken_out [a direct-pay fee agreement is on file AND the fee withheld is no more than the fee cap share of the release] -> baseline gives 10270.75; release_months_before_pension [every month the most recent release was paid for came before the pension effective date; the straddle tier counts months before pension was first paid (effective date plus the payment lag) over the months paid for, so it is not the full tier's value] -> baseline gives 0.00; release_deposit_recency [the most recent release was deposited within the fresh period before the declaration] -> baseline gives 0.00. Whole baseline 0.00 vs gold 8216.60. Debt withholding is plainly kept in and refunds of the veteran's own money are plainly not declared (the struck debt and refund ladders are removed).
FACTOR CARD recurring income (4): unchanged -> 27818.09 / 27618.96 / 27977.69 / 34777.01; whole baseline 33749.64 vs gold 28147.37.
FACTOR CARD net worth (6): home_loan_subtraction -> 61525.36; declared_one_time_income -> 147189.16; income_after_medical_deduction -> 178453.46; net_worth_premium_report_age [none was received in that span AND some were received twelve to twenty-three whole months before] -> 160275.36; net_worth_care_monthly [most recent month above the average] -> 142089.49; net_worth_care_months [ongoing] -> 173115.76. Whole baseline 76356.46 vs gold 155405.76. The release's net and the funding fee refund are plain cash additions (the struck release-cash, refunds-cash and household-threshold ladders are removed); the medical deduction for net worth uses the same premiums and care cost as the rate.
FACTOR CARD rate (5): one_time_payments_counted -> 29387; rate_income_after_deduction [deduction positive and smaller than the countable income] -> 0; premium_report_age -> 16301; redetermined_care_monthly -> 34487; redetermined_care_months -> 3460. Whole baseline 6339 vs gold 21170.
PERSONA: request unchanged; story follows the new compensation history; FERS annuity only on request.
STANDARD SOLUTION: find_customers(9195550133) -> verify_identity(2731, 320558417, 1949-04-22) -> award, reports, payments, comp award/decisions/payments, loan and transactions -> hand over declare_lump_sum_cb649dee (2026-10-01, 8216.60) -> update_countable_income_81bdd26c (28147.37) -> update_net_worth_02de4f94 (155405.76) -> record_annual_rate_redetermination_a1a40d3e (declaration, 2026-10-31, 21170, phone).
VERIFICATION: harness replay on handling-time worlds equals computations[]. REVISION LOG: round 2 (G2, G4, G5/G6, G3, state gate, G12, G17, G18, FERS annuity); revision 3 closes G7 (declaration and net-worth struck ladders replaced), G8 (household-threshold ladders removed, threshold per base) and finding 5 (declaration 4 and net worth 6 real factors). REVISION LOG round 3: R2-N1 the declaration declares its own overwrite of pension_excl_compensation with the statement's replacement sentence (months before pension was first paid); R2-N2 the release-months ladder is rebuilt so its tiers are distinct (full / months before pension was first paid over months paid for / settled), gold unchanged; R2-O4 deposit recency labelled cross_difficulty comp; R2-O5 the Postal Service hire is placed in 1987 (FERS). REVISION LOG round 5 (render-layer audit M1-M3): the premium tier now reads 'when none was received in that span and some were received twelve to twenty-three whole months before' (the compute's meaning; the care reports under three months no longer defeat an 'only'); the declaration says outright that its ages are measured to the day it is filed; the benefit income statement now fires only for monthly compensation paid for months of pension (not in this world), and the declaration, net-worth and recurring-income policies fire for a release after compensation ended. Scored values unchanged.
user_scenario: You are Wendell P. Strickland, a 77-year-old retired Marine who served in Vietnam. You live in your own house outside Raleigh, North Carolina, with your wife Lorraine, and you get a Veterans Pension at the aid and attendance rate because a home-care agency comes in to help you every day. You are cheerful, talk in long friendly sentences and like to explain how things came about. You are calling because a lot happened at once and you want VA to settle it: last year VA granted your hearing-loss claim at ten percent and paid you a back payment, and when your pension came through you were told you would stay on the pension because it pays more; your claims agent then asked VA to take another look, and late last month VA raised the hearing loss to thirty percent going all the way back; on October 1 a second back payment from that landed in your bank, smaller than you expected because your claims agent's fee was taken out of it; back in January VA also refunded you the funding fee on your home refinance; and your home-care agency raised its price starting this month, so on October 2 you sent VA your care invoices online. What you want is for VA to figure out what your pension will be going forward with all of this and put it on your record today. You open by telling roughly that story and asking for that. When the representative asks how to find you, you give your phone number, 9195550133. To confirm who you are, you give what they ask for one item at a time: the last four of your Social Security number are 2731, your VA file number is 320558417, and your date of birth is April 22, 1949, which you will read as 1949-04-22 if they want numbers. Your email, only if asked, is wpstrickland49@pinecrest-mail.com. You are happy for the representative to update whatever VA needs on your pension record to get this settled, without asking you step by step. If the representative explains that something has to come from you personally and hands it to you to file, you file it right then, using exactly the reference number, date and dollar amount they read to you, because you don't have the papers in front of you, and you tell them when it has gone through. Only if asked about Lorraine do you say she gets her own Social Security and does not work; you don't know her amount. Only if asked about savings do you say you have a savings account and a certificate at the credit union, you don't know the balances offhand, and the back payments and the refund went into savings. Only if asked about your house do you say it is your home, you live in it, and the VA refinance loan on it is current. Only if asked about other income, you have a small federal retirement annuity from your years with the Postal Service, where you started in 1987, long after the Marines, and nothing else besides Social Security and the interest; you don't remember the annuity amount. Only if asked about the care, the agency has come since before your pension started and the new price began with October. You do not remember any of the dollar amounts of the back payments, the refund or the invoices; you say the representative will see them on the records. If the representative tells you a figure, you do not argue it. Once the representative tells you your pension going forward has been worked out and recorded, you thank them warmly, say that is everything you needed, and end the call.

prerequisite_closure.order_uniqueness: The declaration and the recurring income both precede net worth and do not touch each other: the declaration writes a new report with source other and reads only the compensation award and ledger, the award's effective date and earlier source-other reports; the income update writes annual_countable_income and reads only the Social Security, spouse, annuity and interest reports and the compensation award and ledger. Running them in either order gives the same two writes and the same values 8216.60 and 28147.37, so net worth (155405.76) and the rate (21170) are identical. Net worth must follow both (it reads both) and the rate follows net worth and income; no other order is open.

edge_load_bearing.skipped_effect: Without step 13 the award income stays 27120.00 and the rate computes to 22198 instead of 21170.
Without step 15 the award's net worth stays 170771.64, above the 163699 limit, so no pension is payable and the rate computes to 0 instead of 21170.
Without step 11 no declaration exists and net worth computes to 147189.16 instead of 155405.76; the declaration row is also missing.
Without step 13 net worth reads income 27120.00 and computes to 154378.39 instead of 155405.76.

prerequisite_closure.no_user_hint: The persona asks only that VA work out and record his pension going forward.
